label: PF Backlog 59
title: Backend: instance role (operator vs tenant) + platform_admin; operator APIs blocked on tenant instances
body: Owner requirement: our platform instance and customer instances must be differentiated so customers never see operator tooling. Design: INSTANCE_ROLE = operator | tenant (env/config; identical on local/dev and Vercel/prod). Platform-level role platform_admin exists only on an operator instance; tenant roles are owner/admin, write, read-only. Operator endpoints (tenants, licenses/keys, trials, pricing, provisioning, feature flags) require INSTANCE_ROLE=operator AND platform_admin - tenant tokens get 403. Same codebase, different surfaces; SaaS = one operator instance + N tenants; self-hosted customer = INSTANCE_ROLE=tenant (no operator console; a small license page only). Server-side enforcement is the gate; UI hiding is cosmetic.
